comingSoonBody: This section is part of the dashboard template. Its data and actions will be wired in the next step.
settingsSubtitle: Your profile and the matching engine. Everything else stays in environment variables.
profileEditSubtitle: Update your name and contact details.
photoPending: New photo — saved with your changes
passwordDescription: The password you use to sign in.
passwordSetHint: Minimum 6 characters. Change it regularly to keep the account secure.
passwordEditSubtitle: Enter your current password, then choose a new one.
matchingDescription: Candidate generation, scoring and background sweeps.
matchingEditSubtitle: Save live engine settings. Healthy processes adopt changes in about 5 seconds; existing results refresh gradually.
matchingLiveNote: Healthy processes adopt saved settings in about 5 seconds. Existing results refresh gradually through normal queued work, not all at once.
matchingConflict: Matching settings changed since you opened this form. Load the latest settings before saving again.
matchingReopenHint: Your draft is preserved. To discard it and use the latest settings, cancel and reopen. If loading fails, retry on the card.
frontierEnabledDesc: Expand candidates through the frontier, independently of the candidate mode.
emptyEncounterDesc: Score when both sides pick “nothing”. It is kept just above the gate so it appears but never outranks a real entry.
emptyMixedDesc: Score when one side picks “nothing” and the other “surprise”. Must stay below nothing ↔ nothing.
minScoreDesc: Both directions of a pair must reach this score to qualify.
minServeScoreDesc: Final-score minimum for a match to be shown.
wMinDesc: How much the weaker direction counts: 0 = average of both, 1 = only the weakest.
weightsDesc: The four final-score weights must add up to 1.
pairBiasDesc: Soft preference for short chains: each member beyond two subtracts this from the ranking.
maxResultsDesc: Best matches kept and served per bond (1–500).
cacheTtlDesc: 0–43200 whole minutes; must also fit within the server's configured serving lifetime.
sweepEnabledDesc: Recompute stale matches on a schedule.
sweepCronDesc: Uses the worker's local timezone, not your browser's. Optional seconds are supported; the server validates the schedule.
legalPublicHint: This content is shown on the public website and app.
legalEmpty: No content has been published yet.
